about:
West Wire is an electrical services company based in Lake Norden, South Dakota. The founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed. The company focuses on providing comprehensive electrical services for new construction projects and service needs across residential and commercial properties in the region.

The company offers a full range of electrical services including wiring and lighting installation, panel upgrades, system integration, troubleshooting, repairs, upgrades, and routine maintenance. Its team of experienced electricians works closely with builders and contractors to meet project specifications and deadlines. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are publicly available.

West Wire serves residential and commercial customers throughout South Dakota, with a service area covering Lake Norden, Bryant, Watertown, Brookings, Lake Poinsett, Hayti, Arlington, Castlewood, Estelline, De Smet, Willow Lake, Erwin, Lake Preston, Clark, and the counties of Hamlin, Clark, Kingsbury, Codington, and Brookings.

The company states its mission is to "illuminate South Dakota one home at a time," emphasizing a dedication to quality, professionalism, and responsiveness in every project.
